items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Yeah, I remember him. And then too there's another fellow by the name of Humphrey. Yeah, Willie.

ctx.x: He fell out, as he says, in the parade about four years ago. Oh, is that? The sun got him out, almost like a sunstroke. He hasn't played hardly a parade since.
Yeah, I remember him. And then too there's another fellow by the name of Humphrey. Yeah, Willie.
Willie Humphrey? Yeah, he still plays Paul Barber.
